model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port keep in Event) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port metric out Snapshot) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (adjacent
      (block ShadowLedger :type "Store"
        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
      (block ShadowBilling
        (port req in Receipt)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
      (block RemoteIndex :type "Process"
        (port in in Event)
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
      (block RemoteSync
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
    (adjacent
      (block RetryPricing
        (port req in Receipt)
        (port out out Command)
        (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
      (block LiveEditor
        (port done out Request)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block Queue
              (port evt in Request)
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block LiveMetrics
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
            (block EdgeSearch :type "Service"
              (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
            (block Editor
              (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
          (block LiveRouter
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block BatchAuth
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block ShadowEditor
              (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
              (level
                (adjacent
                  (block RemoteGateway
                    (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                  (block RemoteLedger
                    (port done out Command)
                    (implements Durable)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block LivePlanner :type "Process"
                    (port emit out Receipt)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block LocalProfile
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))
                (adjacent
                  (block ShadowGateway
                    (implements Observable)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block LocalRenderer
                    (port in in Request)
                    (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))))
            (block RemoteMetrics
              (port evt in Snapshot)
              (port done out Command)
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
            (block Scheduler :type "Feature"
              (port out out Snapshot)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
          (block LocalQueue
            (port req in Receipt)
            (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
          (block ShadowAuth :type "Feature"
            (port in in Snapshot)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
            (level
              (block LocalLedger
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
              (adjacent
                (block Search
                  (port evt in Receipt)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block EdgeFeed
                  (port evt in Snapshot)
                  (port out out Request)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block BatchScheduler :type "Service"
                  (implements Observable)
                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))))
            (level
              (block BatchIndex
                (port emit out Snapshot)
                (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
              (block RetrySearch
                (port emit out Snapshot)
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
              (adjacent
                (block EdgeIndex
                  (port done out Receipt)
                  (implements Observable)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block EdgeMailer :type "Feature"
                  (port evt in Receipt)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                (block EdgeQueue
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))))))))
  (level
    (block RetryFeed
      (port in in Request)
      (port emit out Command)
      (implements Observable)
      (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
    (block Planner
      (port in in Receipt)
      (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
    (adjacent
      (block LocalMetrics
        (port in in Receipt)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Sync
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage.")))))
